dish_name_kh: ឆាខ្ទឹមបារាំង
dish_name_en: Cha Khtuem Barang (Stir-fried Onion with Pork Ribs)

ingredients.raw_kh: ឆ្អឹងជំនីរជ្រូកខ្ចី
ខ្ទឹមបារាំង

steps.text_kh: ឆ្អឹងជំនីរខ្ចីកាត់ដុំៗ ខ្ទឹមបារាំង កាត់បណ្ដោយធំៗ
steps.text_en: Cut the young ribs into pieces; cut the onions into large lengthwise strips.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer cha dish Cha Khtuem Barang (Stir-fried Onion with Pork Ribs), step 1: Cut the young ribs into pieces; cut the onions into large lengthwise strips.

steps.text_kh: ដាំខ្ទះដាក់ខ្លាញ់ឱ្យក្តៅ ដាក់ឆ្អឹងជំនីរជ្រូកខ្ចីឆាចូល ចាក់ទឹកត្រី ដាក់ខ្ទឹមបារាំង អំបិល ស្ករ ម្សៅស៊ុប
steps.text_en: Heat a wok with oil, stir-fry the young pork ribs, add fish sauce, then add onion, salt, sugar, and soup powder.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer cha dish Cha Khtuem Barang (Stir-fried Onion with Pork Ribs), step 2: Heat a wok with oil, stir-fry the young pork ribs, add fish sauce, then add onion, salt, sugar, and soup powder.

steps.text_kh: ចាក់ទឹកខ្លះបន្តិច លាយម្សៅឆាចាក់ចូលបន្តិច ភ្លក្សមើលឱ្យល្មមតាមចូលចិត្ត
steps.text_en: Add a little water, mix starch with water and pour in to thicken slightly; taste and adjust to preference.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer cha dish Cha Khtuem Barang (Stir-fried Onion with Pork Ribs), step 3: Add a little water, mix starch with water and pour in to thicken slightly; taste and adjust to preference.
